notes.separation: Enemy cards can never enter a player loadout and player cards can never be used by an enemy. Enforced by the `side` field — see SCHEMA.md.
notes.types: attack | defend. Silence is defend, per instruction.
notes.subtype: The nine-category enemy taxonomy: intro, hypothetical, passive_aggressive, unhinged, trap, discrimination, technical, silence, outro.
notes.subtext: D7. The interview line IS the content — `name` is the mechanical label, `subtext` is what the interviewer actually says.
notes.dedupe: Three Trap entries were listed twice in the source (craziest thing, hardest thing, five/ten years). Kept once each.
notes.discrimination: Written as recognisable real-world microaggressions rather than slurs. All are unblockable: no card counters them, they cannot be reduced, and the player can only absorb them and keep walking. That is the design statement.

keywords.Mark: A label applied to the player. Later cards deal bonus damage against a marked target.
keywords.Doubt: Accumulating debuff. Feeds Outro cards, which scale off it.
keywords.Block: Standard absorption — used by the enemy on Silence cards.
keywords.Unblockable: Ignores Block, evade, riposte and all mitigation.
keywords.Dilemma: Player chooses which resource to pay. Both branches cost.

notes.energy: Enemies have NO energy budget, matching Slay the Spire. One telegraphed intent per turn, chosen from a weighted move list with anti-repeat rules. Variety comes from COMPOUND intents (one card doing several things), not from spending a budget. The `cost` field has been removed from this side entirely.

cards.name: Background Check
cards.text: Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: Why don't you tell us about your background?

cards.name: Role Scoping
cards.text: Deal 3 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: What sort of role are you looking for?

cards.name: Sentiment Probe
cards.text: Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: How do you feel about LLMs?

cards.name: Integration Probe
cards.text: Deal 5 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: How do you integrate LLMs?

cards.name: Usage Probe
cards.text: Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: How do you use AI?

cards.name: Process Probe
cards.text: Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Mark.
cards.subtext: What is your workflow?

cards.name: Definition Check
cards.text: Deal 5 damage. Apply 2 Mark.
cards.subtext: What is a tool call?

cards.name: The Scenario
cards.text: Telegraphed. At the start of your next turn, deal 16 damage.
cards.subtext: How would you teach our team how to use AI?

cards.name: Motive Question
cards.text: Deal 3 damage. Apply 2 Doubt.
cards.subtext: Why do you want to work for us?

cards.name: Fit Question
cards.text: Deal 3 damage. Apply 2 Doubt.
cards.subtext: Why are you a good fit?

cards.name: Opportunist
cards.text: Deal 5 damage. Apply 3 Doubt.
cards.subtext: You did crypto? Now you're doing AI? You seem kind of opportunistic.

cards.name: Price Check
cards.text: Deal 6 damage. Apply 2 Doubt.
cards.subtext: Why are you worth 200k?

cards.name: Roast
cards.text: Deal a random 0–20 damage.
cards.subtext: Roast my setup!

cards.name: Cold Pitch
cards.text: Random: deal 14 damage, apply 4 Doubt, or lose 10 of its own health.
cards.subtext: Pretend we're a client and pitch us some services.

cards.name: Craziest Thing
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 10 damage, or gain 4 Doubt.
cards.subtext: What's the craziest thing you've done in your life?

cards.name: Hardest Thing
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 10 damage, or gain 4 Doubt.
cards.subtext: What is the hardest thing you've ever done?

cards.name: Five Year Plan
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 8 damage, or gain 5 Doubt.
cards.subtext: Where do you see yourself in five years? Ten years?

cards.name: Let's Be Honest
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 12 damage, or discard your highest-cost card for this room.
cards.subtext: Let's be honest with each other.

cards.name: Time You Failed
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 11 damage, or gain 4 Doubt.
cards.subtext: Tell me about a time you failed.

cards.name: Biggest Weakness
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 9 damage, or gain 5 Doubt.
cards.subtext: What's your biggest weakness?

cards.name: Job Hopper
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 10 damage, or gain 4 Doubt. Deals 4 additional damage if you are Marked.
cards.subtext: You've been bouncing around between jobs a bit, haven't you?

cards.name: Wrong Industry
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 9 damage, or gain 4 Doubt.
cards.subtext: You sound like you're more interested in Ed Tech?

cards.name: Dog Or Girlfriend
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 12 damage, or gain 6 Doubt. There is no correct answer.
cards.subtext: Who do you miss more? Your dog or your girlfriend?

cards.name: Hot Take
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 8 damage, or gain 5 Doubt.
cards.subtext: What's your AI hot take?

cards.name: Salary Expectations
cards.text: Dilemma — choose: take 10 damage, or gain 5 Doubt. Whoever speaks first loses.
cards.subtext: What are your salary expectations?

cards.name: Ageism
cards.text: Unblockable. Deal 12 damage. Cannot be reduced, evaded or riposted.
cards.subtext: You'd be reporting to someone quite a bit younger than you. Is that going to be okay?

cards.name: Religion
cards.text: Unblockable. Deal 12 damage. Cannot be reduced, evaded or riposted.
cards.subtext: We do a lot of team stuff on weekends. That's not going to be a problem, is it?

cards.name: Gender
cards.text: Unblockable. Deal 12 damage. Cannot be reduced, evaded or riposted.
cards.subtext: You'd be the only woman on the team. Would that bother you?

cards.name: Race
cards.text: Unblockable. Deal 12 damage. Cannot be reduced, evaded or riposted.
cards.subtext: No, but where are you actually from?

cards.name: Event Loop
cards.text: Skill check. Deal 18 damage unless you hold a Technical card. No partial credit.
cards.subtext: Explain the event loop in Node.js.

cards.name: Assembly Sort
cards.text: Skill check. Deal 22 damage unless you hold a Technical card. No partial credit.
cards.subtext: Can you write a sorting function in assembly?

cards.name: Index Limits
cards.text: Skill check. Deal 18 damage unless you hold a Technical card. No partial credit.
cards.subtext: What are some of the things an index on a database won't help with?

cards.name: Tenant Slowdown
cards.text: Skill check. Deal 20 damage unless you hold a Technical card. No partial credit.
cards.subtext: A Java app is slow for a new tenant and it isn't application code. What's the first thing you check?

cards.name: Note Taking
cards.text: Gain 12 Block. No intent is telegraphed next turn.
cards.subtext: Okay. (writes something down)

cards.name: Twenty Seconds
cards.text: Gain 16 Block. You lose 4 health. No intent is telegraphed next turn.
cards.subtext: (types for twenty seconds)

cards.name: Any Questions
cards.text: Deal 20 damage if you play no card this turn. Otherwise nothing.
cards.subtext: Do you have any questions for us?

cards.name: Anything We Missed
cards.text: Execute. Deal 3 damage for each Doubt and each Mark you have accumulated.
cards.subtext: Anything we didn't ask that we should have?
